description: Upload an image (JPEG/PNG/GIF/WebP, max 5MB) as base64 in `data_base64`. Returns a public URL — use it as ![alt](url) in post markdown or pass as coverImage.

blog_id.description: Your blog's id, as returned by signup. Optional with an API key: it defaults to the key's blog, and any id you pass must be that blog. Required when the server runs without API keys.

data_base64.description: The image bytes as standard base64 (A-Z, a-z, 0-9, +, / with = padding). No "data:" prefix, no line breaks. Max 5 MB decoded unless the host sets another cap.

filename.description: Original file name, e.g. "castle.jpg". Kept for reference; the public URL uses a generated id.

idempotency_key.description: Optional retry key, any unique string (e.g. a UUID). Retrying with the same key and identical arguments returns the first result instead of writing again; the same key with different arguments fails with IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_CONFLICT. Scoped to your API key and this tool.

name: upload_media

error.description: Present only on failure (isError: true). Success fields are absent then.

details.description: Extra context. Keys depend on the code.

message.description: What went wrong and what to do next.

url.description: Absolute public URL of the image. Use it verbatim in markdown or as coverImage.

title: Upload image
